text: Voltaire's Candide was banned in France on 25 February 1759 and in Switzerland on 26 February 1759, the year it was published. The Vatican banned it in 1762. In 1929 U.S. Customs seized it in Boston, on its way to a Harvard French class, and in 1944 the Post Office barred its listing in a dealer's catalogue.
